propositions: The mypy typecheck target (Makefile:241-242) covers only src/rebar but not scripts/, leaving 47 type-unchecked .py files under scripts/ despite them being lint-clean and CI-gate-invoked

15 mypy errors exist across 6 files in scripts/ (7 in check_raw_git_writes.py, 4 in plan_review_impact_distribution.py, 1 each in capture_jira_fixtures.py, probe_rebar.py, check_complexity_baseline.py, t5c_calibrate.py) — all fixable without suppression, and 2 represent latent bugs (str|None.strip() and incorrect None-guard scope)
Widening the typecheck target to include scripts/ is feasible because sys.path bootstraps in 9 files are already accommodated by pyproject.toml's follow_imports=silent and ignore_missing_imports=true
Scripts that enforce the Verified vote (e.g. check_verify_gate_parity.py) must themselves be type-checked to ensure correctness of gating logic
Stale scope descriptions in .pre-commit-config.yaml and .github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml refer to 'full library' / 'full src/rebar' and must be updated to reflect widened scope
